body:
### What problem does this solve?

right now the vibey loops are separate repos. historically this was necessary, it no longer is. those repos need to be merged into a single monolithic microservices kubernetes cluster with helm charts, kustomize, etc, etc, and all the loops need to be libraries contained in that cluster with individual loops able to be spun up or down elastically when the code is run as needed and when the context demands it

### Proposed solution

wrap *loop repos into a single vibey-loops repo that wraps all the others into a minikube microservices monolith
once confirm it's fully done and working, tell me and we can decide what to do from there :)

### Alternatives considered

_No response_

### Anything else?

_No response_

## Triage — 2026-09-17 (`develop` @ f2467910, v0.8.0)

**Status: PARTIAL** · size **XL** · confidence high

**The ask, as read:** Merge the separate *loop repositories into one repository, and turn them into a Kubernetes microservices cluster (helm, kustomize) where each loop is a library in the cluster that can be spun up and down elastically as the workload demands.

### What already ships
- The five loop repositories are merged into one tree with history preserved (src/vibey_runners/*, ADR-0021) — the consolidation half of the ask, delivered under a different name than 'vibey-loops'
- A Helm chart exists and installs on minikube, verified by a cluster-smoke CI job with four asserted contracts
- Elastic scale-to-zero-and-back exists via KEDA on a claimable-work query — for the single generic worker pool, not per loop
- A VibeyProject CRD and kopf operator give a declarative in-cluster entry point (ADR-0025)
- In-cluster engine auth preflight (cluster_preflight.py) already knows every runner's API-key variables and is wired into the CLI

### Evidence in the tree
- SHIPPED — consolidation: docs/architecture/decisions/0021-one-tree-history-preserved.md:1-19 records all five runners imported with `git subtree` into src/vibey_runners/<name> with history preserved; pyproject.toml:78-81 registers `src/vibey_runners/*` and `src/vibey_tools/*` as uv workspace members; `ls src/vibey_runners/` = agy, claude, codex, common, cursor, qwen
- SHIPPED — helm: deploy/helm/vibey/{Chart.yaml,values.yaml} and templates/{worker.yaml,postgres.yaml,operator.yaml,keda-scaledobject.yaml,crd-vibeyproject.yaml}
- SHIPPED — minikube proof: .github/workflows/ci.yml:448-507+ `cluster-smoke` builds deploy/docker/Dockerfile into minikube's daemon, `helm install`s the chart, and asserts four contracts (park-not-crash-loop, project pickup, ScaledObject Ready, drain)
- SHIPPED — elastic scaling, but of one generic pool: deploy/helm/vibey/templates/keda-scaledobject.yaml scaleTargetRef is `{{fullName}}-worker` (the single worker Deployment), triggered by one claimable-work SQL query; values.yaml keda.minReplicas 0 / maxReplicas 4
- SHIPPED — operator/CRD: deploy/helm/vibey/templates/crd-vibeyproject.yaml + operator.yaml, recorded in ADR-0025
- SHIPPED — in-cluster engine preflight: src/vibey/infrastructure/cluster_preflight.py:35-41 ENGINE_API_KEY_ENVS maps each EngineId to its API-key variables and check_engine_auth (around line 99) flags an installed-but-unauthenticated engine; reachable in production via src/vibey/cli/main.py:1156-1175
- …and 9 more

### What is actually left
- Phase 0 spike, per runner: settle whether claudeloop / codexloop / cursorloop can run their autonomous loop headless in a container at all, or whether bootstrap.py must gain a runtime lane selector like agyloop's `--gateway sdk|cli`. Nothing downstream can be planned until this is answered (runbook 16:63-78)
- Bring src/vibey_runners/qwen/deploy/docker/Dockerfile to the image contract the vibey image already meets (no pip, fixed non-root uid, tini as PID 1 — see deploy/docker/Dockerfile:60-95 and ADR-0026)
- Write a Dockerfile per remaining runner (claude, codex, cursor, agy), including the vendor-binary question each one raises, and add a multi-arch publish job to .github/workflows/ci.yml beside the existing `image` job
- Build the `vibey-engines` image that layers the runners on the vibey base, so an in-cluster worker can run a real provider instead of `--provider scripted`
- Add a Helm chart per runner so `helm install claudeloop` runs a standalone session with no vibey in the picture (runbook 16 goal 1)
- Decide and implement the microservices boundary the issue actually asks for: today loops are subprocess CLIs inside the worker pod (loop_process_adapter.py:117). Per-loop Deployments require a call protocol (queue-claim per engine, or gRPC/HTTP) that does not exist
- Add per-loop elastic scaling: one ScaledObject per loop with an engine-scoped claimable-work query, replacing the single pool-wide ScaledObject in keda-scaledobject.yaml
- Add kustomize overlays if the ask is to be honoured literally — there are none today
- …and 9 more

### Blockers
- Runbook 16's Phase 0 is unresolved: three of four hosted-model runners hardwire the vendor agent gateway and need the vendor CLI binary on PATH, and those CLIs assume an interactive TTY login that does not exist in a cluster. Image size, base image, and whether a container can authenticate at all all hang on this
- qwenloop needs model weights in the image or on a volume, and a GPU for the vLLM profile — a cluster-capacity prerequisite the operator must provide
- Real engine credentials are required to prove anything beyond `--provider scripted` in CI; the current cluster-smoke job deliberately avoids them

> ⚠️ **Verdict corrected by the verifier.** The verdict label survives, but the auditor's SHIPPED list does not: four of its five bullets are pre-existing conductor infrastructure that landed BEFORE the issue was filed, and the fifth is factually wrong. Issue #121 was created 2026-08-31T02:15:00Z (scratchpad/issues/121.md). `git log --reverse` shows deploy/helm/ (chart, worker.yaml, keda-scaledobject.yaml) and the cluster-smoke CI job all arrived in 1918e94a, 2026-08-21, PR #73; crd-vibeyproject.yaml and src/vibey/infrastructure/operator/ in e1820c77, 2026-08-21, PR #76; src/vibey/infrastructure/cluster_preflight.py in a4731cd6, 2026-08-21, PR #74. All ten days before the issue existed. That is the baseline the operator was complaining about, not progress against the complaint. The ONLY thing in the auditor's shipped list that postdates the issue is the subtree consolidation (5d7b51059 2026-09-10 'chore: import claudeloop into src/vibey_runners/claude (history preserved)' and four siblings; verified by `git log --all --grep=git-subtree-dir`, ADR-0021 docs/architecture/decisions/0021-one-tree-history-preserved.md:9), and even that was runbook-19 family-consolidation work, not #121 work. Verified against the full ask ('all the loops need to be libraries contained in that cluster with individual loops able to be spun up or down elastically'): zero percent of that exists. deploy/docker/Dockerfile:52-56 copies only src/vibey/ and src/vibey_tools/skills/; ADR-0025 states 'Engines do not ship in the image; in-cluster runs are --provider scripted'; values.yaml:18 provider: scripted; a full-tree grep of deploy/ finds exactly one mention of any loop anywhere — crd-vibeyproject.yaml:78 `enum: [claudeloop, codexloop, cursorloop, agyloop]`, a string allow-list, not a workload. One Chart.yaml exists in the whole repo; one Dockerfile is built by CI (ci.yml:368-392, tag vibey:ci); the only per-runner Dockerfile (src/vibey_runners/qwen/deploy/docker/Dockerfile) is orphaned — referenced solely by docs/runbooks/expansion/16-loop-runner-containers.md:39, built by no CI job and consumed by no chart. Nothing in the tree is named vibey-loops (grep returns nothing).

**Notes:** Two different asks live in this one issue and they have opposite verdicts. (1) 'Merge the *loop repos into one repo' is done — but as absorption into `vibey` (ADR-0021), not as a new `vibey-loops` repository; that specific framing is obsolete and the issue should say so rather than stay open against it. (2) 'A minikube microservices monolith where each loop is a library in the cluster, spun up and down elastically' is essentially not started: deploy/docker/Dockerfile:52-55 deliberately excludes every runner subtree, ADR-0025:23 concedes engines do not ship in the image, and the one Deployment plus one ScaledObject scale a generic worker pool rather than individual loops. The cluster machinery that does exist (chart, KEDA, operator, preflight) is real and production-wired, which is why this is partial and not not-started — but it is scaffolding for the conductor, not for the loops. Recommend closing this issue and reopening as two: 'runner images + vibey-engines image' (blocked on the Phase 0 spike) and 'per-loop services with per-loop autoscaling' (blocked on the first).


<sub>Automated triage pass: every open issue re-read against the tree at `develop@f2467910`, each verdict then attacked by an independent verifier whose job was to refute it. Supersedes the 2026-09-15 triage, which was measured at 0.7.0.</sub>
The following PRs have been merged into develop and may address this issue: #273, #258, #250, #243

**Status: PARTIAL · planning size: XL**

The workspace now absorbs the loop family and includes deployment/local-engine work. A complete single vibey-loops minikube microservice monolith, elastic loop scaling, and full Helm/Kustomize lifecycle proof are still not established.
